markets.title: Will the Fed funds target rate be above 3.75% after the September 2026 meeting?
markets.rules_primary: If the upper bound of the federal funds target range is above 3.75% at settlement, the market resolves Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The source agency for this market is the Federal Reserve. Settlement uses the target range published after the FOMC meeting.

markets.title: Will Dune: Part Three win Best Picture at the 2027 Oscars?
markets.rules_primary: If Dune: Part Three wins the Academy Award for Best Picture at the 99th Academy Awards, the market resolves Yes.
